heroImage.licenseNote: Daytime shot of the venue's own rooftop pool and sea-view deck at Ilha Porchat, sourced from the FOTOS gallery on AMUSE's own official site (amuse.com.br) -- this is the actual venue, not a generic overlook. No identifiable faces in frame. Used as venue promotional material with the same implied consent this skill extends to a venue's own official site; unedited, full-resolution original (4032x3024). Replaces the earlier Wikimedia Commons Ilha Porchat overlook shot, which was explicitly not venue-specific.

statusHistory.note: Baixada Santista content push (near-war-room), acting on BACKLOG.md's São Vicente leads paragraph -- Amuse Club, flagged there as needing verification before drafting, not assumed from the backlog note alone. Operator-directed research pass (chat request) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Verified current via its own Instagram (@amuseclub), which shows live September 2026 programming -- a 5th-anniversary party on Sept 5, recurring 'Baile da AMUSE' nights, and cross-promoted dates with House of Mamba Negra (a ballroom/voguing collective) and Festa Pandora -- plus a live Facebook page and third-party QLIST listing, all corroborating the Al. Paulo Gonçalves, 680, Ilha Porchat address and sea-view rooftop/indoor-outdoor dance floor setup. No boat-party programming was found this pass despite the backlog note flagging it as a possibility -- not included in the copy since it can't be substantiated. The House of Mamba Negra connection is real and current per the venue's own Instagram, but a standalone Near piece on São Vicente's ballroom scene was not written this pass since House of Mamba Negra's own base/schedule could not be independently verified beyond this cross-promotion -- logged to content/requests.md instead of forced. Coordinates approximate for the Ilha Porchat address, not an independently verified geocode pin -- confidence 0.6. Hero image is the public Ilha Porchat overlook (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0) the venue itself sits on top of, not a venue-interior photo -- logged as a compromise pending a real photo.

P0 geolocation correction: verified AMUSE Beach Club's own Google Maps listing and replaced the previously documented approximate Ilha Porchat coordinate with its listing pin (-23.9805185, -46.3699319).

near-illustrator pass, operator ask ("get better hero images for quiosque da cris and amuse club in sv too"). Checked photo inbox (nothing for this slug), then AMUSE's own official site (amuse.com.br, found via its Instagram bio link) per the skill's mandatory second-stop order -- its FOTOS gallery page hosts real, unwatermarked, venue-specific photography. Selected the daytime rooftop-pool/sea-view shot (source filename IMG_0622.jpg, iPhone 12 Pro EXIF, 4032x3024) over several nighttime interior/dance-floor shots on the same page: it's the strongest, most legible landscape frame, has no identifiable faces (the interior shots are otherwise clean too but this one reads best at thumbnail size and clearly shows the Ilha Porchat perch that's the venue's whole pitch). Also checked @amuseclub's Instagram grid directly per the queer-beat-hero directive (this piece is the directive's origin case) looking for a pride-flag-forward shot -- found none; the grid is entirely close-up patron portraits (identifiable faces, unusable) and event flyers, no flag imagery. Downloaded original, hosted at public/places/amuse-beach-club-sao-vicente/hero-rooftop-pool.jpg, replacing the generic Wikimedia Ilha Porchat overlook that was explicitly flagged as not venue-specific. Verified pixel dimensions (4032x3024, well clear of the 1200px/300,000px/16:9 card spec) before committing. Quiosque da Cris's existing hero (hero-kiosk-flag.jpeg) was also reviewed this pass and left unchanged -- see that piece's own statusHistory.
